rules: Use bold/black weights for pyramid section titles.
Keep body text small (text-xs or text-sm) to ensure it fits perfectly inside the trapezoid bands without touching the clipped borders.

layouts.main_wrapper: flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-8 overflow-x-auto w-full p-8 items-start
layouts.left_sidebar: w-[300px] flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col gap-4 bg-white p-6 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-gray-200
layouts.pyramid_section: flex-1 min-w-[1500px] flex flex-row items-end gap-2 relative
layouts.pyramid_core: w-[1200px] h-[800px] relative flex flex-col-reverse overflow-hidden
layouts.right_wedges: w-[250px] flex flex-col-reverse h-[800px] justify-between pb-4

components.EditableWhiteSpace: bg-white text-black text-right px-2 py-1 rounded w-32 border border-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 font-mono text-sm
components.StatusDot: w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 border-white cursor-pointer shadow-sm transition-colors duration-200 flex-shrink-0
components.WedgeLabel: bg-gray-500 text-white font-bold text-sm px-4 py-2 rounded-r-full shadow-md flex items-center mb-1

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. You MUST build the main pyramid container using `w-[1400px] h-[800px]` (or similarly huge base) with `clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%)` applied to the WRAPPER. The user specifically asked to 'FAI PIU LARGA LA BASE E VEDRAI CHE POI CI STARA TUTTO' (make the base wider so everything fits).
2. Inside the clipped wrapper, stack 8 rows using `flex flex-col`. Heights from bottom to top: 15%, 15%, 15%, 15% (for red/green levels) and 10%, 10%, 10%, 10% (for teal levels).

3. EACH ROW must perfectly center its content (`flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center p-2`). Because the wrapper is clipped as a triangle, the corners of the flex rows will be cut off, making them look like trapezoids. The extremely wide base ensures the centered text never hits the clipped diagonals.

4. For levels 1 to 4, layout the fields elegantly: Title at top, then a flex row/grid of the specific inputs. Example Level 1: 'IN CASO DI INVALIDITÀ DOVUTA A' (bold title), below it 3 columns: 'Malattia, sei protetto fino a [input €] [dot]', 'Infortunio...', 'Non autosufficienza...'. Use text-xs or text-sm for these labels.
5. The white spaces MUST be editable inputs `<input type='text' />` styled to look like white boxes.
6. The Dots must have local state (React `useState`) to cycle between Green ('ADEGUATO'), Yellow ('NON ADEGUATO'), and Red ('ASSENTE') on click.
7. Top-left of the entire screen must contain the company logo. Use the provided image URL.
8. The Left Sidebar must contain all the requested income data fields (IL TUO REDDITO ATTUALE, ESTRATTO CONTO CONTRIBUTIVO, etc).

9. The Right Wedges must be positioned outside the pyramid on the right. They map to the heights of the pyramid: INVESTIMENTO (maps to top 10%), RISPARMIO (maps to next 30%), PROTEZIONE DEL PATRIMONIO (maps to next 30%), PROTEZIONE DEL REDDITO (maps to bottom 30%). Use simple absolute positioning or flex to align them to the pyramid levels.
10. The Footer must contain 'TESTAMENTO Sì/No' + 4 'EREDI LEGITTIMI' boxes.

logo.description: Company Logo placeholder to be placed in the top-left corner

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath.
Ensure all interactive elements have hover effects and transition states.
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (inputs, dots, buttons).
Do not use generic Inter font for headings.
Ensure a 100% functional, horizontally scrollable layout for smaller screens so the massive pyramid is not squeezed or deformed.
